body:
**Bug:** dropped folders used `webkitGetAsEntry()` → snapshot-only;
reloading didn't reflect disk edits; user had to re-drop.

**Fix:** `DropZone.tsx` now tries `DataTransferItem.getAsFileSystemHandle()`
first. If it returns a `FileSystemDirectoryHandle`, we call a new
`folderFromHandle()` helper in `fs.ts` (extracted from `pickFolder`):
persists the handle to IDB, walks the directory, registers session
handles, treats exactly like an Open Folder-sourced folder. Disk edits
flow back on every view.

**Limit:** loose single-file drops still snapshot — the Web API
doesn't give us a parent directory handle from a file item, and
filemark's store only knows folder handles. Workaround: drop the
parent folder.

---
